original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚法律援助委员会通过性暴力识别与转介工具
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚法律援助委员会（LACoN）与欧盟支持终止性暴力和性别暴力（ESGBV）项目于周二在阿布贾召开利益相关方验证研讨会，审议并验证用于识别和应对性暴力和性别暴力的新工具。研讨会评估了性暴力识别指南、修订后的法律援助受理表格及结构化转介路径。正式通过后，这些指南和工具预计将在LACoN各运营办公室推广。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚法律援助委员会与ESGBV项目在阿布贾召开利益相关方验证研讨会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Legal Aid Council of Nigeria (LACoN) and the European Union Support to End Sexual and Gender-Based Violence (ESGBV) Programme in Nigeria, implemented by International IDEA on Tuesday convened a stakeholder validation workshop in Abuja.

key_facts.fact: 研讨会旨在审议和验证用于识别和应对性暴力和性别暴力的新工具
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the workshop was to review and validate newly developed tools for identifying and responding to sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) within legal aid service delivery

key_facts.fact: 利益相关方评估了性暴力识别指南、修订后的法律援助受理表格和结构化转介路径
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The stakeholders assessed SGBV identification guidelines, revised legal aid intake forms, and structured referral pathways developed under the ESGBV Programme in Nigeria.

key_facts.fact: 正式通过后，经验证的指南和受理工具预计将在LACoN各运营办公室推广
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On formal adoption, the validated guidelines and intake tools are expected to be rolled out across LACoN’s operational offices.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
指南和工具尚未正式通过，推广仍属预期
